verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents an MCP integration that connects Claude directly to live Puzzle ledger data for natural-language queries (puzzle-docs-22/33), and separately markets an 'ask anything about your business' natural-language interface with examples like cash trending and profitability (puzzle-docs-9), plus an API for real-time financial insights (puzzle-docs-1/21/32). Together these show an ai-native user could ask an agent an affordability-style question grounded in live ledger data pulled via the API/MCP. Missing for 10: a concrete example or hands-on demo of an 'can we afford X' style query, and independent (non-vendor) corroboration that answers are accurately grounded rather than hallucinated.
